execution: eda_workflow run-questions -> EP with dataset accounting -> reused EC -> EP-finalize with dataset accounting -> selected R EV; stops at EV by default; explicit --until ER enables downstream review.
scope: Descriptive plots of already materialized source records. No extraction, inference, fitting or scientific approval. Explicit source-bound C(t)/Dose arithmetic is supported with an independent operand ledger and unchanged raw data.
selection_policy: Choose a supported display for the observation question and verified record level. Do not assign a plot simply because columns are numeric. A paper is visual guidance, not permission to borrow its data, fitted curve, uncertainty or assay limit.
rules: The existing source-bound EDA Rules remain authoritative and unchanged.
shared_constraints: Retain species, matrix, analyte basis, dose/route, source time origin, record level, status and source cells.

For admitted animal PK concentration-time evidence, plan linear and semilog views by default: absolute profile/peak/sampling on linear axes and relative decline/low concentrations on log10 axes. Reuse the same source observations and verified grouping. Zeros, BLQ and missing values do not cancel a usable semilog view: preserve them in source records and concise per-figure status notes; never add offsets, substitute a limit or bridge unsupported observations. If no positive concentration with a supported numeric time exists, document the semilog exception and retain the supported linear/table view. Retain alternative time columns in provenance; only an applicable source conflict or explicit request permits a diagnostic. This default does not apply to categorical endpoints, MIC, dosing designs, in-vitro response or already-log CFU. A straight segment does not establish a terminal phase or model.
Missing and censored responses are not numerical observations. Preserve them in the companion ledger and break connected guides at these rows.
Straight connections are descriptive guides, never fitted predictions or demonstrated individual trajectories.
Error bars require supplied, corresponding uncertainty values and a known definition. SD, SEM and confidence intervals are not interchangeable.
Use one evidenced main time axis; alternate diagnostics require an applicable conflict or explicit request; do not snap digitized times or reconcile source conflicts.
Keep source tables for unsupported displays and describe the exact limitation. Never invent geometry to avoid a table.
Paper captions and methods were inspected; original paper image pixels were not used as a visual validation reference.

templates.purpose: Compare source-reported mean PK profiles across explicit routes/doses within a matrix.
requires: Mean-summary record level
Explicit numeric time and concentration
Supported series membership
templates.render: geom_point + segmented geom_line; facet_wrap by matrix and time-axis alternative
restrictions: No inferred individuals
No line for duplicate times within a series
No added SD
Panel Y ranges may differ and must be disclosed

templates.purpose: Show terminal observations without implying longitudinal pairing.
requires: Source treatment categories and raw endpoint values
This template validates pre-treatment, vehicle/control and PMB category order
templates.render: geom_point with deterministic categorical offsets; strain/dose facets
restrictions: Offsets have no measured meaning
No newly computed summaries or tests
No connections between different terminal units

templates.purpose: Show reported endpoint means and their supplied uncertainty.
requires: Known mean field
Corresponding quantified nonnegative SD or SEM
Known endpoint unit and group scope
templates.render: geom_point + geom_errorbar; optional source-reported baseline and n labels
restrictions: Do not compute or convert uncertainty
ND stays unavailable
No inferred individual pairing or dose-response fit

templates.purpose: Show time-kill observations in explicitly permitted source-file/ID series.
requires: Source note explicitly permits file/ID membership
Observation-event role is identified
Unique corresponding concentration event per source ID
templates.render: geom_point + segmented geom_line; per-figure status notes for non-plotted responses
restrictions: No inferred replicate IDs
No model curves
Do not plot censored placeholder values
No borrowed LOQ or censor direction
No second log transform

requires: Ordered source categories
Reported category frequencies and known unit
restrictions: An open-ended category is not an exact concentration
Do not renormalize percentages
No claim of PTA weighting adequacy

templates.purpose: Show independent source index-response markers without adding a fitted relationship.
requires: Explicit numerical coordinates and source index identity
templates.render: geom_point; separate index panels with explicit units
restrictions: No connections between independent markers
No cross-panel marker matching
No Emax curve, index ranking or PD target
Retain unresolved response-axis ambiguity

templates.purpose: Registered source-native PK column views, separate-matrix reported intervals, binding assays, static time-kill summaries, categorical baselines, MIC values/bounds and regimen design.
requires: A registered recipe matching source title, column semantics and source-note signature
Source fields, status and uncertainty definition validated before EP selection
DH source points may use a unique explicitly declared time/response pair, verified Data role and descriptive permission; no lines, identity inference or uncertainty calculation.
templates.render: R points, supplied SD bars, categorical panels, explicit MIC threshold markers, optional semilog and per-figure non-observation status notes.
restrictions: No longitudinal joins from source column labels
No review-status promotion from display parsing
No derived fu or daily-dose calculation
No automatic linear/log pair; EP must justify each view

templates.purpose: Compare concentration per documented dose within one verified comparable scope.
requires: Exact source-bound dose contract
At least two positive doses
Known dose basis and time/concentration selectors
No applicable upstream restriction
templates.render: R calculates C(t)/Dose from retained raw operands; Python independently verifies every value.
restrictions: No inferred dose conversion, AUC, fit or proportionality conclusion
Retain zero-dose controls unnormalized
Missing/censored values remain explicit; no imputation

not_implemented: Box/violin plots from verified replicate distributions
coverage_policy: All admitted datasets and potential display fields are accounted for in EP and post-EC EP. Missing recipe support is explicit. An omission fails before rendering; no extra repair agent or backward loop.
